stage1.impression: A clear, legible idea: a rim-lit globe of six coloured rings on a black drum at a canal's edge, with its coloured shadow laid on the paving in a cool spotlight pool. It still reads as a competent CG mockup rather than a night photograph: the foreground paving is brighter than the hero, the coloured shadow is a pale pastel inside a blue-white pool, the facades across the canal are a flat repeated window grid, and the haze shows grain. A jury would see a specific work, but in a generic rendered place rather than a real Amsterdam quay.

blocking_9: The coloured shadow must be the brightest, most saturated thing on the ground: shadow region [520,470,740,640] clearly saturated in the disc colours, against a darker surrounding quay, with no lit paving brighter than it
Foreground paving [0,600,300,800] must fall to night levels (lum_median about 30 to 45), not 113, so the eye goes to the globe and its shadow
The spot's pool should be warm-neutral (about 3500 to 4000 K), not blue-white against a 3500 K balance, so the coloured shadow reads as colour, not as a tinted cold patch

The far facades must read as Amsterdam canal houses (gabled, varied widths, brick with mortar texture, uneven window lighting with curtains and interiors), not one long flat block with a regular window grid
The rims must glow strongly enough to read as light sources at a glance and give a soft glow on the plinth and nearby paving
No visible grain in the haze/sky and no flat CG surfaces at 1:1 (paving joints, plinth steel, bollards)

defects.what: Foreground paving is lit flat and bright (lum_median 113, warm), brighter than the hero; an unexplained fill
Coloured shadow is low saturation pastel (median RGB 89/67/70); colours of the six discs are barely distinguishable
Spot pool is blue-white (5000 K under 3500 K balance) and reads as a stage light, not part of the night street
Facades across the canal are one flat dark block with a regular, repeated window grid and card-like lit interiors; no gables, no brick texture, no variation
Sky and haze around the left lamp are bright (lum_median 100) and grainy; haze glow is flat and noisy
Rims are thin and dim (region lum_median 35); the globe reads as wire rings rather than glowing acrylic edges; no glow spill on plinth
Plinth is a plain smooth black cylinder (lum_median 19), no blackened-steel sheen or edge highlight
Barrier ring rope reads as a thin black wire drawing hard lines across the shadow and foreground; clutters the shadow image
Bicycle behind the globe is half hidden and confuses the globe's silhouette
Paving texture faint and uniform (lum_range 22.6), reads as a smooth CG plane at 1:1
Water reflections are soft vertical smears; plausible but low contrast, no specular ripples of the globe's colours

changes.problem: The foreground paving is the brightest large area in the frame, pulling the eye off the globe and its shadow.

evidence.measured: lum_median 113.1, r/g/b 133/110/86, versus shadow region lum_median 73 and frame median 42

change.to: 2 x point 60 W, 2700 K, placed so the near lamp is out of frame behind camera-left or removed; keep exposure 3.6 and lift the spot instead (c2)

changes.expected: Foreground falls to a dim warm night level with the spot pool clearly the brightest ground area.

changes.problem: The coloured shadow is washed out and cold, so the frame's purpose (the globe drawn a second time in colour) does not land.

evidence.measured: median RGB 89/67/70, lum_median 73; colours near-neutral pink-violet; pool around it reads blue-white

change.to: 1600 W, cone 14 deg, 3800 K, aim [0.5, -1.6, 0.0] so the full shadow lands inside the pool with a 0.5 m margin

changes.expected: A bright warm-neutral pool with distinct red, blue, yellow, green, orange, violet bands in the shadow; pool edge falls off naturally into the dark quay.

changes.problem: The rims are too dim to read as light; the globe looks like wire rings and casts no glow on its plinth.

evidence.measured: lum_median 35.1, p95 177; plinth [320,540,520,670] lum_median 18.9 with no colour spill

changes.expected: Rims read as glowing coloured edges with a soft halo, and the plinth top and nearby paving pick up a faint coloured spill.

changes.problem: The far facades read as one flat CG block with a regular window grid, killing the sense of a real Amsterdam canal.

evidence.measured: uniform dark mass, lum_median 34, windows in an even grid with card-like interiors

change.setting: the houses across (materials' finish; lit windows)
change.from: one continuous facade, 0.32 lit at glow 0.1
change.to: 5 to 7 narrow canal houses of varied width and height with gables and cornices, brick with mortar texture and slight colour variation, 0.25 lit at mixed 2400 to 3000 K with curtains and varied interior depth

changes.expected: Unmistakably an Amsterdam gracht at night; the background earns the place without competing.

changes.problem: The barrier ring and its rope draw hard black lines through the coloured shadow and the foreground, and the bicycle confuses the globe's silhouette.

evidence.measured: black rope arc and posts cross the shadow; bicycle at [290,360,340,420] tangled behind the rings

change.from: barrier ring r 2.4 m rope at 0.45 m; bicycle behind the globe
change.to: remove the ring, or make it a low 0.1 m kerb ring of stone at r 2.6 m; move the bicycle to lean on a bollard at x 3.5 m, outside the globe's silhouette

changes.expected: The shadow reads as an uninterrupted drawing of the globe on the paving; the globe silhouette is clean.

changes.problem: The paving and plinth read as smooth CG planes at 1:1.

evidence.measured: lum_range 22.6, faint uniform brick pattern; plinth flat black with no edge highlight

change.to: Amsterdam klinker brick in herringbone with recessed sand joints, per-brick colour and roughness variation, slight damp sheen (roughness 0.35 to 0.6); plinth blackened steel with uneven sheen and a crisp edge highlight

changes.expected: Ground texture holds at 1:1; the spot pool picks out individual bricks; the plinth shows a thin top-edge highlight.

changes.problem: The sky and haze top-left are too bright and grainy for a night canal, and the lamp's halo is a flat noisy smear.
changes.expected: A deep blue-black sky with a tight soft halo round the lamp, no grain.

changes.problem: The water reflects only soft smears; it misses the globe's coloured reflection, the strongest photographic proof of place.

change.to: smaller, sharper ripple (wavelength about 0.3 m), roughness 0.02, so lit windows break into streaks and the globe's rims, after c3, show broken coloured streaks

changes.expected: Crisp broken streaks from windows and a hint of the globe's colours on the water.

out_of_scope.request: Clear the discs' faces further so the shadow carries less overall tint and stronger colour only at the rims
out_of_scope.why: The disc tint and clear faces are part of the fixed globe design

out_of_scope.request: A taller or lighter plinth so the globe separates from the dark quay
out_of_scope.why: The low round plinth is fixed

out_of_scope.request: The brief asks the stage-1 bar to judge a listening-bar interior; this frame is an outdoor light artwork
out_of_scope.why: Judged against the card's purpose (a night photograph of the work in place); the interior criteria (acrylic premium, cozy, one colour) were applied as far as they transfer
